instantiate_device_type_tests: instantiate device-specific test classes from a generic unittest test template for each available device type
ops_decorator: parametrize a test function over a list of OpInfos to run it for each operator on supported device types and dtypes
dtypes_decorator: parametrize a test function over specified datatypes with optional per-device-type dtype overrides
skip_cuda_if: skip a test on CUDA devices when a given condition or attribute is true
precision_override: specify per-dtype precision tolerances for test assertions in device-generic test classes
